description: The Battle of the Water Calibration Networks is a benchmark for calibrating water distribution models, contributed by Avi Ostfeld of the Technion to the Water Distribution System Research Database as entry 33. The entry page offers one EPANET zip, and DataCite lists the deposit under the title Calibration Networks; the page links only a PDF whose file name suggests it is shared with other entries, and the summary spreadsheet has no counts. Coverage is a synthetic benchmark problem for demand and roughness calibration, so no place or date applies beyond the 2016 deposit. The file is free; the page states no licence, only a copyright notice. Only the index page, the entry pages, the summary spreadsheet and DataCite metadata were read; no network file was downloaded or run. The network supports calibration research, sensor-placement and data-assimilation tests, and comparison of parameter-estimation algorithms. Related records: the Battle of the Water Futures dataset, EPANET and the database record. The sister Battle of the Water Sensor Networks entry has no file link on the WDST site and is covered in the record of entries listed without file links.
